title: Fight Erupts At Popeyes Between Customer And Staff [Watch]
htmlContent:
A woman at a Popeyes discovered how difficult it is to play with restaurant workers is probably not a good idea.

An absolutely absurd video shows an altercation that started at the cash register when a client and a Popeyes employee both seemed to throw something at one another.

Those people did not agree on fried and juicy chicken sandwiches. They were trading shots after they decided to throw stuff at the register.

Popeyes is supposed to be a place for tasty chicken, but that's not what happened here.

Although it is honestly unclear who started it, the situation shows that you are probably cooked if the figures are off your side. There were several people who beat up this customer. She had virtually no chance outnumbered at least 4 to 1 once the melee truly kicked off.
